penalties.authority: Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Appeals (Bandra Division), Mumbai
penalties.details: An appeal order dated 06 January 2026 was passed partially allowing the appeal filed by the Company against the original order issued under Section 73 of the CGST/MGST/IGST Acts. The impugned order dated 11 May 2022 has been modified. The tax demand has been substantially reduced, with most of the tax liability deleted and only a limited portion sustained along with applicable interest and penalty.
penalties.impact: a. Post appeal: Net payable reduced to ₹88,786 (excluding pre-deposit adjustment). b. No material operational impact; financial impact limited to the reduced liability.
